interface.longDescription: Honor an explicit dao-home, dao-browser, or dao-lite choice. Otherwise, use dao-home for Home projects, dao-browser for existing Dao tabs or windows, and dao-lite for background web tasks with your sign-ins. You can watch, take over, or stop background tasks from the sidebar.
defaultPrompt: Use dao-lite to open https://example.com in a background task and report its title.
